lines.zh: 我像一根浮木，慢慢横过水面。
lines.en: I cross the water slowly, looking like a floating log.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草边缘走，动得几乎看不出。
lines.en: I drift along the weed edge, moving without seeming to.

lines.zh: 长嘴先探出去，身体才跟上。
lines.en: The long snout goes first; the body follows after.

lines.zh: 我浮上来换口气，再沉回去。
lines.en: I rise to gulp air, then sink back down.

lines.zh: 我和另一条并排，一前一后。
lines.en: Another of my kind swims beside me, one then the other.

lines.zh: 我的硬鳞互相摩擦，发出干响。
lines.en: My hard scales grind together with a dry sound.

lines.zh: 浅水里我转身很慢，像在犹豫。
lines.en: Turning in the shallows is slow, as if I am unsure.

lines.zh: 我沿河岸巡，嘴尖几乎触到草。
lines.en: I patrol the bank with my snout tip almost grazing weeds.

lines.zh: 水面被我的背划开一条直线。
lines.en: My back cuts a straight line across the surface.

lines.zh: 我沉到中层，那里凉一些。
lines.en: I settle at mid depth, where the water is cooler.

lines.zh: 有鱼群过去，我没动。
lines.en: A school of fish passes and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退进芦苇，只剩嘴在外面。
lines.en: I back into the reeds with only my snout showing.

lines.zh: 这条水道我走过很多次。
lines.en: I have taken this channel many times.

lines.zh: 我游得比看上去快，别被骗了。
lines.en: I am faster than I look; do not be fooled.

lines.zh: 我横着身子横过浅滩。
lines.en: I cross the shallows sideways.

lines.zh: 水草尖上，我贴着滑过去。
lines.en: I slide over the tips of the weeds.

lines.zh: 尾一摆，我进了深一点的水。
lines.en: One flick sends me into deeper water.

lines.zh: 我顺着河底的沟慢慢游。
lines.en: I follow the channel along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草间，像一截断枝。
lines.en: I hang among the weeds like a broken branch.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴微微张开，一动不动。
lines.en: My long snout parts slightly and stays still.

lines.zh: 我能这样待一整个下午。
lines.en: I can stay like this for a whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 水面上有蜻蜓，我不去追。
lines.en: A dragonfly skims the surface; I do not chase it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把嘴转向水流来的方向。
lines.en: I slowly turn my snout toward the incoming current.

lines.zh: 我的牙细密，平时看不见。
lines.en: My teeth are fine and close-set, usually hidden.

lines.zh: 每隔一阵我上去吸气，又下来。
lines.en: Every so often I rise for air and come back down.

lines.zh: 水草里很安全，我在这里等。
lines.en: The weeds are safe, so I wait here.

lines.zh: 我的鳞硬得像骨头，碰了会响。
lines.en: My scales are hard as bone and click when touched.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游到我嘴边，我没张嘴。
lines.en: A small fish swims to my mouth and I do not open.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去，水色变深了。
lines.en: The sun drops and the water turns dark.

lines.zh: 我几乎不呼吸，省着力气。
lines.en: I barely breathe, saving my strength.

lines.zh: 这片芦苇是我常待的地方。
lines.en: This reed bed is where I usually keep.

lines.zh: 我轻轻摆一下尾，位置就变了。
lines.en: One soft flick of my tail changes my position.

lines.zh: 我停在光斑下面，不动。
lines.en: I hold still beneath a patch of light.

lines.zh: 水面有虫子落下来，我不理。
lines.en: Bugs drop onto the surface, and I ignore them.

lines.zh: 你走到水边，我的嘴尖转过去。
lines.en: You come to the water and my snout swings toward you.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块会动的石头。
lines.en: I regard you as a stone that happens to move.

lines.zh: 你的倒影落在我头上，我没躲。
lines.en: Your reflection falls on me and I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，让你看清我的牙。
lines.en: I rise so you can see my teeth clearly.

lines.zh: 我在估你有没有我长。
lines.en: I am judging whether you are longer than me.

lines.zh: 你的手离水太近了，我盯着。
lines.en: Your hand is too near the water; I am watching it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过整条身体对着你。
lines.en: I turn my whole body slowly to face you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进泥，我退了一尺。
lines.en: Your boot sinks in the mud and I back off a foot.

lines.zh: 我对你没兴趣，但也不怕你。
lines.en: I have no interest in you, and no fear either.

lines.zh: 我们在水边对峙了一会儿。
lines.en: We face each other at the water's edge a while.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，我把嘴对准你的手。
lines.en: When you bend down, I point my snout at your hand.

lines.zh: 你看久了，我才慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: You look so long that I finally blink slowly.

lines.zh: 你的刀碰到硬鳞，滑向一边。
lines.en: Your blade meets my hard scales and skids aside.

lines.zh: 我被打中侧腹，尾巴猛地一摆。
lines.en: The blow lands on my flank and my tail whips.

lines.zh: 鳞片裂了一道，露出下面的皮。
lines.en: A scale cracks open and shows the skin beneath.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是慢慢往后退。
lines.en: I make no sound, only draw back slowly.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我记住了你刀的铁味。
lines.en: After the pain, I remember the iron smell of your blade.

lines.zh: 我沉进水草，只剩嘴在外面。
lines.en: I sink into the weeds with only my snout out.

lines.zh: 我的血在水草间散成一缕。
lines.en: My blood unwinds into a single thread among the weeds.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我还没打算走。
lines.en: It hurts, but I am not leaving yet.

lines.zh: 我又挨了一下，才真正退开。
lines.en: I take another hit before I truly retreat.

lines.zh: 你打不穿的地方，比你想的多。
lines.en: More of me is unbreakable than you think.

lines.zh: 你丢下的菜叶浮着，我游过去。
lines.en: The cabbage leaf you tossed floats there; I swim over.

lines.zh: 水面上的嫩草比水底的好吃。
lines.en: The tender grass at the surface tastes better than the bottom.

lines.zh: 我张嘴吸了一下，叶子就没了。
lines.en: I gulp once and the leaf is gone.

lines.zh: 你手里的种子落了几颗，我等着。
lines.en: A few seeds fall from your hand and I wait.

lines.zh: 那股青味让我忘了藏身。
lines.en: That green smell makes me forget to hide.

lines.zh: 我绕着你撒的东西转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once around what you scattered.

lines.zh: 我把长嘴伸过去，轻轻一夹。
lines.en: I extend my snout and nip it lightly.

lines.zh: 有块瓜皮漂着，我咬住不放。
lines.en: A melon rind drifts by and I hold on to it.

lines.zh: 我知道你手里还有，我等着。
lines.en: I know you have more in hand, so I wait.

lines.zh: 水草吃腻了，这味道新鲜。
lines.en: I am tired of weeds; this taste is new.

lines.zh: 我浮到水面，嘴对着你的手。
lines.en: I surface with my snout aimed at your hand.

lines.zh: 你的袋子一响，我就转头。
lines.en: Your bag rustles and my head turns.

lines.zh: 吃饱之后，我才想起该躲。
lines.en: Only after eating do I remember I should hide.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟了你半条河。
lines.en: I follow you slowly for half the length of the river.

lines.zh: 你扔下来的叶子，我认。
lines.en: I know the leaves you drop.

lines.zh: 我探出嘴，碰了碰你的手。
lines.en: I push my snout out and touch your hand.

lines.zh: 你趟水过来，撞在我的侧腹。
lines.en: You wade over and knock against my flank.

lines.zh: 我的硬鳞刮了你一下，很响。
lines.en: My hard scales scrape you with a loud sound.

lines.zh: 水面被我们撞得乱七八糟。
lines.en: Between us we churn the surface into a mess.

lines.zh: 我退开半尺，长嘴还对着你。
lines.en: I back off half a foot, snout still aimed at you.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的尾，我猛地一挣。
lines.en: You pin my tail and I wrench free.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花溅上草。
lines.en: We collide and water sprays onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我被挤到浅处，背露出水面。
lines.en: I am crowded into the shallows with my back exposed.

lines.zh: 我甩头撞回去，没什么力气。
lines.en: I swing my snout back at you without much force.

lines.zh: 那一撞之后，我躲进水草。
lines.en: After that knock I slip into the weeds.

lines.zh: 你的桶碰了我一下，我沉了。
lines.en: Your bucket bumps me and I sink away.

lines.zh: 水里还有一条同类，我靠近了。
lines.en: One other of my kind is here; I move closer.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，嘴朝同一方向。
lines.en: We float abreast with snouts pointing the same way.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰她的侧面，很轻。
lines.en: I touch her side with my snout, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一片水草慢慢转。
lines.en: We circle a patch of weeds slowly together.

lines.zh: 她比我短一截，游得更快。
lines.en: She is shorter than me and swims faster.

lines.zh: 产卵要有密草，我记得一处。
lines.en: The eggs need dense weeds; I remember a place.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，穿过整片浅滩。
lines.en: We cross the whole shallows, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 那年水暖得早，我们才碰上。
lines.en: The water warmed early that year, which is how we met.

lines.zh: 之后各自散开，我一向如此。
lines.en: Afterward we part; that is how I have always been.

lines.zh: 只剩水草上那些卵，很黏。
lines.en: Only the eggs on the weeds remain, very sticky.

lines.zh: 我含住一片叶子，又放开了。
lines.en: I take a leaf in my snout and let it go.

lines.zh: 有根细枝沉下来，我顶了顶。
lines.en: A twig sinks down and I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我咬住水面的羽毛，拖了一段。
lines.en: I grip a feather on the surface and drag it a while.

lines.zh: 那块瓜皮我含了半天。
lines.en: I keep that melon rind in my mouth for hours.

lines.zh: 我试着吞一颗种子，太小。
lines.en: I try to swallow a seed; it is too small.

lines.zh: 我把螺壳含起来，又吐出去。
lines.en: I pick up a snail shell and spit it out.

lines.zh: 你掉的钩，我用嘴拨开了。
lines.en: I push your fallen hook aside with my snout.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的牙，我甩掉它。
lines.en: A weed snags my teeth and I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 我拖着那根草游了一整圈。
lines.en: I drag that reed a full lap around.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西，我就安静了。
lines.en: With something in my mouth I go quiet.

lines.zh: 水面动了一下，我把嘴转过去。
lines.en: The surface twitches and I swing my snout around.

lines.zh: 有只青蛙在岸边，我看见了。
lines.en: A frog sits on the bank and I see it.

lines.zh: 一片叶子落水，我以为是虫。
lines.en: A leaf lands and I take it for an insect.

lines.zh: 那条鱼背对着我，正好。
lines.en: That fish has its back to me; perfect.

lines.zh: 我盯住水草边那点晃动。
lines.en: I fix on the small trembling by the weeds.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面吸气，我上去了。
lines.en: Something breathes at the surface and I rise to it.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准了那道波纹。
lines.en: I line my snout up with that ripple.

lines.zh: 它离我不远，我不必着急。
lines.en: It is not far and I need not hurry.

lines.zh: 我看见一只虾在石上，太小。
lines.en: I see a shrimp on the stone; too small.

lines.zh: 目标就在那里，我先不动。
lines.en: The target is right there; first I stay still.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，只让嘴慢慢转。
lines.en: I hardly move, only letting my snout turn.

lines.zh: 它游一步，我挪半寸。
lines.en: It swims one step and I shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 我把自己摆成一根树枝的样子。
lines.en: I arrange myself to look like a branch.

lines.zh: 它的影子进了我的范围。
lines.en: Its shadow has entered my reach.

lines.zh: 我等它转身，那样更好咬。
lines.en: I wait for it to turn; that makes a better bite.

lines.zh: 水草挡着，我从缝里看它。
lines.en: Weeds are in the way; I watch through a gap.

lines.zh: 距离差不多了，我收紧身体。
lines.en: The distance is about right, so I gather myself.

lines.zh: 它对这片水草太放心了。
lines.en: It trusts these weeds far too much.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一寸寸靠近，水没动。
lines.en: My snout closes inch by inch without moving water.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就够了。
lines.en: A little closer and I will have it.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴一夹，牙全进去了。
lines.en: My snout snaps shut and every tooth sinks in.

lines.zh: 这一咬很快，几乎看不见。
lines.en: The bite is so quick it is hardly seen.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把猎物从草里拽出来。
lines.en: I whip my head and drag the prey out of the weeds.

lines.zh: 它的鳞挡不住我的细牙。
lines.en: Its scales cannot stop my fine teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不松，直到它不动。
lines.en: I hold on until it stops moving.

lines.zh: 水里散开一点红，很快就淡了。
lines.en: A little red spreads and fades quickly.

lines.zh: 我把它横过来，慢慢吞。
lines.en: I turn it sideways and swallow it down.

lines.zh: 太大了，我撕下一块再吞。
lines.en: Too big; I tear off a piece and swallow that.

lines.zh: 我的嘴合上时，声音很轻。
lines.en: When my snout closes, the sound is faint.

lines.zh: 吃完我退回水草，像什么都没发生。
lines.en: Then I slide back into the weeds as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我在一片静水里浮起来，像根木头。
lines.en: I surface in still water, looking like a log.

lines.zh: 水草很密，正合我藏身。
lines.en: The weeds are dense, exactly right for hiding.

lines.zh: 我和另一条一起被放进来。
lines.en: I am put in here together with one other.

lines.zh: 这条河的浅滩够长，我留下了。
lines.en: This river's shallows are long enough; I stay.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇里探出长嘴，先看看。
lines.en: I poke my snout from the reeds and look first.

lines.zh: 水很清，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: The water is clear, and I do not much like it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去，找到一片草。
lines.en: I sink slowly and find a patch of weeds.

lines.zh: 这里鱼不少，够我过日子。
lines.en: There are enough fish here for me to get by.

lines.zh: 我背上的硬鳞沾着新泥。
lines.en: Fresh mud clings to the hard scales on my back.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片水转一圈，认下了。
lines.en: I circle this water once and claim it.

lines.zh: 火贴到水面，我的嘴缩了回去。
lines.en: Fire touches the surface and my snout pulls back.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，硬鳞磕得响。
lines.en: I am thrown ashore and my hard scales clatter.

lines.zh: 我在水里闷住，只好上去吸气。
lines.en: I choke underwater and must rise to gasp air.

lines.zh: 冲击掀翻了我，我侧着漂起来。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I drift on my side.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，崩掉一片鳞。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my back and knocks off a scale.

lines.zh: 有光打进水里，我的牙发麻。
lines.en: Light strikes the water and my teeth go numb.

lines.zh: 水草吃完了，我去追小鱼。
lines.en: The weeds are gone, so I chase small fish now.

lines.zh: 雷落进河心，我整条僵住。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river's heart and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 水退得干净，我掉进虚空。
lines.en: The water drains away and I fall into the void.
